title: 2570. Merge Two 2D Arrays by Summing Values

examples.explanation: The resulting array contains the following: - id = 1, the value of this id is 2 + 4 = 6. - id = 2, the value of this id is 3. - id = 3, the value of this id is 2. - id = 4, the value of this id is 5 + 1 = 6.
There are no common ids, so we just include each id with its value in the resulting list.
